title: My character skinned in 3dsmax looks a bit different after exporting as an open-collada format.
content: Skinning an avatar in 3dsmax includes two categories called "Skin" and "Physics". An Open-Collada file format can only support the "Skin" way perfectly. If you face an issue importing an Open Collada file or importing an avatar including animation, please try with FBX either Alembic file format with PC2.
content_description: This web page aims to guide users on the best practices for skinning avatars in 3ds Max and troubleshooting import issues with Open-Collada files by suggesting alternative file formats.

title: Shirring and Crease Principle
content: ### Shirring principle In this course, we will explore the different types of shirring shapes based on fabric. In addition to the wrinkles generated by the default fabric, there are various types of wrinkles, such as narrow wrinkles and wide wrinkles. You can achieve the desired wrinkles by adjusting the Detail items in the Fabric Property, but it may be challenging for beginners. However, if you understand the differences in how each fabric forms wrinkles, you can easily create various styles of wrinkles. ### Crease principle In this course, we will learn about the shape of creases based on fabric. When fabrics are stretched or overlapped with each other, various creases are formed based on the type of fabric. Following the Shirring principle, you can refer to the creases made for each fabric and apply them to the clothes you plan to create in the future.
content_description: This web page aims to educate users on the principles of shirring and creasing in fabric design, enabling them to create various wrinkle and crease styles for their clothing projects.

title: When I try to login, I get the following massage "Due to a network issue, you are unable to login at this time"
content: This error message occurs when there is a failure between server connections. In case you are receiving this message while using the Marvelous Designer 8, then please first check if your network connection is stable or you have input wrong password or not. If you input the right login credential, you would be able to activate the license successfully with the onlineauth method. If you keep facing this issue however, please refer to the ([manual page](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358427341465)) for offline authentication method activation. For all the other versions with the same issue, please follow the instructions below for its solution. Also, please make our server address whitelist on your antivirus program. ![with.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438097204377) * **With “Firewall Option” enabled** 1. Open HTTPS port 443 which is the blocked server. 2. When you login, please check on the box saying “If using a Firewall, mark this checkbox”. 3. Make the Marvelous Designer’s server whitelisted. If you are residing in China, please use the second address. 1. IP: 52.1.24.50 (api.clo3d.com ) 2. IP: 52.20.29.14 (api.clo3d-china.com) 4. Please activate the license. ![without.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438112145689) * **With “Firewall Option” disabled** 1. Open HTTPS port 443 which is the blocked server. 2. Make the Marvelous Designer’s server whitelisted. If you are residing in China, please use the second address. 1. IP: 52.1.24.50 (api.clo3d.com ) 2. IP: 52.20.29.14 (api.clo3d-china.com) 3. Please activate the license. **[How to open port 443 and whitelist Marvelous Designer’s server IP address.]** **1\. Open the control panel and go to 'Windows Defender Firewall' sections.** ![Xwaqc1aLWHzM0RKZWm5Phggk3suThFUkJYj8AIe7kiWJIdr1DvYVne9eXxunzy2oFpxgfCGTWT7OPnfYklNbMjQD1OZkb12QfrdXCgXTfNQg2ElNrH3XOkZgh0sxKfcA4Vq1Zto5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438162539801) **2 Go to 'Advanced settings' and click 'Inbound Rules'.** ![4dK68hcJOhqp7mRu0Ym7az9xExTFwR7xOm1065mQKOZaepfbn7xVpMjt3QrpwPni6VgAz0o9izAL9mXmMSkj4ed8izWStWhv-ydTtMO45nV5svqIprl4bK0cDmT2u3P45nhyoTVB.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438097738905) **3\. On 'Action' menu, click 'New Rule'.** ![zTxrlfuGDX5qr_TWWaT4fssmuj3lCguT9KoHMrOFsdNrmAA3Gf6c_T05SbqupRo7-PO6V2WNSwNPF4IbcpN656bYALlITJ1OZlbkB_G7c08E62HLJURs9cOOjuKjGwZ078BQyl4Y.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438098004761) **4\. Select 'Port' and click 'Next'.** ![JNVEfASi4Iquw6yPPEvNK3pG3yjuO_61SBCDjwaTJpIbI5Jlp1Mhmqugrt9AQHyMnm7EMuul04yu4XidQ7XmXjvcNHtGFvA1s7vidFOJhITMcjRuWvPKbyGFOUEDTJPLiSepBU8-.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438098300441) **5\. Select 'TCP' and input '443' on the 'Specific local ports' section.** ![1gZV5mqSlg-TnT3TbECybl1oarVggQvu1TldW7TVY_PqVap4zsDpYfz1yRoelGvIpzWI754ksplWuGoM-ucNsxvw_cEAXEimq8qQOgSJTGfKuPsUu2RRZpsIarozrwRkfGZ4UtBD.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438145964441) **6\. Select 'Allow the connection' and click 'Next'.** ![KRcTmTLslRbRy1U_1WgfWS7KevQ7JGMG79Jw7QQZTIqLOgTQ73n7MqqQCSlravyldXSZVVzt_HPxBXWCN-3GnSp-64SJOMtsJQAN7QcWRzOUtPQJf7rkmocFxxOa1BYBlFBYbGeP.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438148995353) **7\. Check on all 3 check boxes and click 'Next'.** ![eN_eA2OrGXIkNIRztTi_Km49Er9Rhk6r3V84ZMDCtUygwxBr3klQA0Zvxk4txAZ3f1d5I2Sb5xJ-WQoFZuiDxWHwscqVfzLSeUISs5DrlrAPIclBz56Z4SwDWGqEcAIbqVDwiAVB.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438135403673) **8\. Input the rule name and click 'Finish'.** ![nOYjpKgChfk0KkSqsyWCrrFTfH8dszdhJdu7d3-BEFiNwpyNrujQnC69AxXjrD2r_IbNMBLpd9arzeJ0i-PXnHJYvUTwLouzyEU88eB5byQg7A_TW1ZBMgoAjLbyhl1p69HeDp3z.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438163877273) **9\. Open the 'Port 443's 'Properties'.** ![Wl0V_7FdzGp7eNbPpA-3VvsKXx0VA2Sq90G7GaGyKwytWKnj4met7xsPi3xanfDR1DFRU7xwoMdUglLrFnFxGWAyd6on8TKuV7CfrZ3lJUuCX9tEsc88jiC_Zi5wl2oWM4aYx74v.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438113652121) **10\. Go to the 'Scope' and select 'These IP addresses' on the 'Remote IP address' window, and click 'Add'.** ![MctTcujBgKVx0tipYoKY0DYDjheVSJk_CUCDu5k7wLEz2naSBm1qTmNCr8rZqv8x3TzNrGa_lzLYmQQVGJqcdz06kZEq41_1vx1pysv_RWFPa7NxRfUpKJWwBNrKycCLSeRHAzod.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438149915545) **11\. Input the following info on the 'This IP address or subnet' and click 'OK'.** ![c_3KC_I_mHFKs1h0IygAWZriUWzDwn4_iYG3tI379M0n7weixajkYIFZkQhNy5Uu_axnJ62jInfQvjzbqPuRimAz9mIzZBsKqgd2iqKx9X4xkFNlWGIotp9ERjxAQQ8ENatIiEUf.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438150128537) **In case you are still experiencing this issue after the guideline above, please refer to the instructions below.** **Step 1.** Open c:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\host file as a text file **Step 2.** Add # at the front for the lines that includes api.clo3d.com or sapi.clo3d.com After add # for the lines in the front, please try to login again.
content_description: This webpage provides troubleshooting steps for resolving server connection errors in Marvelous Designer 8, including network checks, firewall settings, and license activation methods.

title: Academic License Purchase Guideline
content: * Marvelous Designer academic purchase becomes available for online purchase (for qualified academic institutions - authorized governmental agencies for teaching/learning purposes.) * You can purchase the academic license on behalf of your academic institution if the above condition is applicable. _This manual is created for those who are purchasing academic license of Marvelous Designer for the first time. If your school has purchased a license before, you will be able to purchase online immediately with your company ID._ **For new academic users online purchase process** **Step 1.** Please sign in with your school's Company ID <https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/member/signup/company> (You can create a company ID for your school that will be used for admin purposes) **Step 2.** Click "START NOW" on the Academic tab and submit the school's information. <https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/pricing?type=academic> ![academic.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438577137049) **Step 3.** Submit the information on the registration page. **Step 4.** After reviewing your submission, we will send you an email when you will be able to proceed with your purchase online.
